visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young East Asian male (77BOSS) with dark hair and a black t-shirt stands in a bright indoor studio with white shelving. He holds a white plastic pregnancy test displaying two pink lines directly toward the lens. Large yellow text '兩條線' is centered over his face. He exhibits high-arousal facial expressions with wide eyes and an open-mouthed grin. (2) The scene cuts to the man gesturing with the test while speaking. He turns his head to the side as if addressing someone off-camera. The background remains the white studio with minimalist decor. (3) A close-up shot reveals a single red strawberry held next to the pregnancy test. A yellow question mark variety-show graphic appears near the strawberry. (4) A montage sequence shows white strawberries (pineberries) in a bowl. A hand inserts a pregnancy test into one of the fruits. The scene shifts to a retail pharmacy where the man and a woman in a white hoodie browse shelves of packaged tests and place them into a blue shopping basket. (5) Back in the studio, the main male character sits with another male guest in a white t-shirt. They handle the tests and laugh. Animated blushing and anger symbols appear over the main character's face. (6) A woman wearing a black halter-neck top demonstrates inserting a test into a red strawberry on a white table. The man watches intently. A digital clock graphic showing '10:00' with a ticking hand is overlaid on the screen. (7) The man holds up a strawberry-punctured test showing two lines, celebrating by waving it. The woman brings in a Chucky doll and throws colorful plastic balls/confetti into the air. (8) A split-screen comparison shows multiple tests inserted into various strawberries, all with two pink lines visible. The man points at the camera during the closing frames, holding the Chucky doll.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched, excited male vocal shouting "Ha!" followed by a fast-paced Mandarin narration. A bright, percussive electronic BGM kicks in at ~128 BPM with a bouncy synth melody. A distinct "pop" sound effect marks the appearance of text on screen. (2) A sharp "ding" SFX rings as the speaker mentions his wife. The BGM maintains a consistent upbeat tempo. Ambient studio noise is negligible, indicating a clean, post-produced environment. (3) A comedic "sliding whistle" or "boing" SFX accompanies the reveal of a strawberry. The vocal pitch rises with curiosity. (4) During the shopping montage, a high-frequency "beep" SFX simulates a barcode scanner. The BGM remains in the background, providing a lighthearted comedic atmosphere. (5) In the studio discussion, multiple short vocal segments from the host and guest overlap. A "whoosh" transition SFX occurs during a jump cut. A stylized "angry grumble" sound effect is played when a frustration graphic appears. (6) Wet, squelching percussive sound effects occur as the characters handle the strawberries. A comedic laughter track is layered under the conversation. (7) A rhythmic "ticking" clock SFX is introduced during the 10-minute wait graphic. (8) A triumphant "success" stinger/chime plays as the result is revealed. The audio concludes with a celebratory fanfare, cheers, and a final "ding" chime as the host points to the audience.
